rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hands that feel both cold and damp.

example.english: Your hands are clammy; did you just touch ice?
example.traditional: 你對手又凍又濕，係咪啱啱掂過冰？
example.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 sau2 jau6 dung3 jau6 sap1 hai6 mai2 ngaam1 ngaam1 dim3 gwo3 bing1

rows.note: Use this when the damp, clammy feeling is more noticeable than the coldness.

example.english: Your hand feels clammy, so don't touch my book.
example.traditional: 你隻手濕笠笠嘅，唔好掂我本書呀。
example.jyutping: nei5 zek3 sau2 sap1 nap6 nap6 ge3 m4 hou2 dim3 ngo5 bun2 syu1 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the coldness of the hands is more noticeable and the dampness is understood from context.

example.english: My hands felt clammy while I was waiting for the bus this morning.
example.traditional: 朝早等巴士嗰陣，我對手凍冰冰嘅。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 dang2 baa1 si2 go2 zan6 ngo5 deoi3 sau2 dung3 bing1 bing1 ge3
